bannerText: Lost contact with the mother device.
bannerNoGame: This device has no saved game to take over - promote a device that was in the game.
rejoinNotFound: No mother found on the network for this game.
becomeMotherBody: Make THIS device the mother for the current game. It adopts the latest saved state, and the other devices reconnect to it automatically. Use this when the original mother has crashed.
becomeMotherNote: A few seconds of scans made right before the crash may be missing. Only promote one device.
promotedBody: This device is now the mother. The other devices will reconnect to it within a few seconds.
stickyMotherNote: This device will stay the mother at next start. To undo: Settings → Network → Advanced → "I'm not a mother" (possible once the game has ended or another device took it over).
apDownBody: This device has taken over the game, but its Wi-Fi hotspot is not up - the other devices cannot find it yet.
apDownHint: Retry below, or start the hotspot from Settings → Network. The game itself is safe on this device.
regainBody: The game "{{name}}" is currently hosted by another device - it took over while this one was offline. Take back control on this device?
regainNote: This device pulls the latest game state from the current host before taking over, so nothing is lost.
regainTaking: Pulling the latest state and taking over…
regainDone: This device is now the mother. Open the game to continue - other devices will reconnect.
errSnapshotFetch: Could not fetch the current game state from the active mother - it may have just gone offline. Try again.
errNoSnapshot: No cached snapshot for this game on this device - it can't be promoted. Pick a device that was in the game.
errNotInGame: This device was not part of any active game (no saved state, and no other host is reachable). Join the game on this device first, or take control from a device that was in it.
errTakeControl: Could not take control: another device may already be the current mother. Try again in a few seconds.
errMotherUnreachable: The current mother is not answering. Check that it is on, that Playground is open on it and that this device is on the same Wi-Fi, then retry.
errStaleSnapshot: This device already holds a newer copy of the game and can host it directly. Use "Take control" in Settings → Network → Advanced.
errScenarioMissing: This device hasn't downloaded this game's scenario. Sync it (Settings → Sync), then retry.
errAdoptFailed: Taking over the game on this device failed and was rolled back: nothing was changed. Retry; if it happens again, take over from another device.
errPortBusy: Another program is using Playground's network port on this device. Close other Playground windows, then retry.
errNoWifiCreds: This device doesn't know the Tag Hunter Wi-Fi name and password, so the access point could not start. Sync the device or enter them in Settings → Network → Advanced.
errHotspot: This device's Wi-Fi access point could not start. Retry in a few seconds; if it persists, start it from Settings → Network.
errNotAuthorized: The current mother refused this device. Join it first (Settings → Network → Find a mother), then retry.
errGeneric: The operation failed. Retry in a few seconds; if it happens again, send the technical details to support.
errHostingActiveGame: This device is hosting a running game ("{{name}}") and no other mother serves it. End the game, or have another device take it over first ("Make mother" on one of its satellites).
regainNoOther: No other mother can be reached: this device stays the mother.
promotedBodyHotspot: This device is now the mother and broadcasts the Tag Hunter Wi-Fi. Satellites rejoin on their own within about a minute; otherwise, on the satellite: Settings → Network → Find a mother.
bannerReconnecting: Reconnecting to the mother, please don't touch anything.
takingOverBy: {{name}} is taking over, reconnecting, do not touch anything.
alreadyTakenOver: {{name}} has already taken over: this device joined it, nothing else to do.
